user.title: Connect Brandweerrooster
user.description: Use your Brandweerrooster account. The integration uses the documented Brandweerrooster API v2.

scope.title: Station and incidents
scope.description: Choose the station/group and optionally additional groups or tasks that should count as relevant incidents. Incidents are received from the official FireServiceRota integration; the Brandweerrooster API is queried only when a new incident is detected.

error.rate_limited: Brandweerrooster is temporarily rate limiting API requests. Wait a moment and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Brandweerrooster account is already configured.
